card_text: Braids for men coming from Artesia: text the style first, clear a long block, and why rows suit a hot, dry summer.

seo.title: Braids for Men from Artesia, NM | Divinely Faded, Carlsbad
seo.description: Men's braids for Artesia, done by Tim in Carlsbad about 44 minutes down US 285. Text a photo first, book a block you can give up, and plan for the heat.

paragraphs: I braid in Carlsbad, {{city:artesia.drive_mi}} miles south of Artesia on {{city:artesia.route}}, around {{city:artesia.drive_min}} minutes each way (OpenStreetMap routing). A set of braids is one of the longest sittings on my menu, which changes how you plan the trip.
Settle the style by text, pick a slot you can fully give up, and the drive becomes the easy part.

blocks.heading: Agree on the set by text.
paragraphs: Booksy lists Braids with the price as varies, because the price follows the set: how many rows, whether they meet at the crown, whether you want cuffs on the ends. Send a photo to {{phone}} and I'll tell you what that style runs before you commit to the road.
From Artesia that avoids a wasted trip: nobody wants {{city:artesia.drive_min}} minutes on the road to learn the style needs more length than they have.

blocks.heading: One service, one long block.
blocks.lead: Booksy holds the full time for a set.

items.title: Braids
items.body: A personalized set, over a fade or taper if you want one. Booksy blocks {{minutes:braids}}, so pick a slot with nothing waiting behind it.

blocks.heading: Rows keep the hair off your neck.
paragraphs: Artesia sees roughly {{city:artesia.days_100f}} days a year at 100°F or more, with humidity averaging about {{city:artesia.humidity_pct}} (Open-Meteo, 2023–25). Braids hold the hair tight to the scalp and a fade underneath leaves the sides bare, so less sits on your neck through a summer like that. Air that dry also dries the scalp under the rows, so oil it between washes and the set lasts better.

blocks.heading: Make it a morning.
paragraphs: Braids plus the round trip is most of a half day. On Saturday I open at 8:00 AM, so the first slot of the morning puts you back on 285 toward Artesia well before the afternoon, with the rest of the weekend untouched.
A missed braids slot is a hard one for me to refill, so if plans change, cancel on Booksy as early as you can. A late cancellation or a no-show may carry a fee.

items.a: The same from Artesia as from across the street: it varies by style. Text me a photo first and ask.

items.q: How long is the whole trip?
items.a: Roughly {{city:artesia.drive_min}} minutes down, {{minutes:braids}} in the chair, {{city:artesia.drive_min}} minutes back. Clear the block.

items.q: Can the sides be faded in the same visit?
items.a: Yes. Most sets on the braids page sit over a fade or taper. The fade grows out before the braids do, so the sides may bring you back down sooner than the rows.
After the set is finished: cash, card, Zelle or Cash App.
